question.prompt: 3 times a number minus 5 equals 16. Find the number.

solutions.explanation: Let the number be \(x\). Set up the equation \(3x-5=16\). Solving gives \(3x=21\), so \(x=7\). Check: \(3\times7-5=16\), which satisfies the conditions of the problem.
solutions.title: Set up and solve a simple equation
